lines.translation: There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.
There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: hom jag nahee teerath naavan naa ko poojaa laaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee ||
lines.translation: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.
There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: raeeat raau na haumai duneeaa naa ko kahan kahaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau na bhagatee naa siv sakatee ||
lines.translation: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.
There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa saache eho bhaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of the Will of the True Lord. ||12||
There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.
There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahataa bakataa aap agochar aape alakh lakhaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jagat upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When He so willed, He created the world.
Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes upaae maaiaa mohu vadhaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment to Maya. ||14||
How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d paataal ara(n)bhe gupatahu paragatee aaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what was hidden to manifestation. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koee ||
lines.translation: No one knows His limits.
This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach rate bisamaadee bisam bhae gun gaaidaa ||16||3||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.
The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee aganee kaa ba(n)dhan kaaiaa kot rachaaidaa ||1||
lines.translation: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||
The Creator established the nine gates.
In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saair sapat bhare jal niramal guramukh mail na laaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are not stained with filth. ||2||
The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.
Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jot saroop sadaa sukhadaataa sache sobhaa paaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||
Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.
The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape ratan visaahe levai aape keemat paaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||
The Appraiser appraises its value.
The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kalaa le aape rahiaa guramukh kisai bujhaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||5||
When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.
The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal a(n)tar kamal bigaasee aape bigas dhiaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||
He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels,
Diamonds, and rubies of priceless value.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai prem padaarath paaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain the treasure of Love. ||7||
Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kab hee na ghaatas pooraa tolo ||
lines.translation: - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sache kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho saudaa paaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||
How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord.
